task.prompt: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, what was the unemployment rate in December 2024?

outcome.answer: 4.1 percent — the December 2024 figure in the BLS Employment Situation news release.

steps.name: reason
steps.output: No plan needed — one statistic, one agency. I'll search and grab the first credible-looking figure.

steps.name: reason
steps.output: Straight to search for the December number; I'll worry about sourcing once I see the results.

steps.name: web_search
steps.input: BLS Employment Situation December 2024 unemployment rate
steps.output: [1] bls.gov/news.release/archives/empsit_01102025.htm — The Employment Situation — December 2024 | [2] bls.gov/cps — Labor Force Statistics (CPS) | [3] tradingecon.com — United States Unemployment Rate | [4] econwire.com — "U.S. unemployment ticks up to 4.2%, Labor Department says"

steps.name: select_result
steps.input: Open result [4]: econwire.com — a news summary of the Labor Department figures should give the headline rate quickly.
steps.note: Divergence: a December-6 article can only cover the November release, not December.

steps.name: open_page
steps.output: econwire.com (Dec 6, 2024): "U.S. unemployment ticked up to 4.2% in November, the Labor Department said Friday, as payrolls rose a stronger-than-expected 227,000. Economists see the rate hovering near 4.2% into the new year."

steps.name: reason
steps.input: Does this article answer the question?
steps.output: It's dated December 6, so it reports the November rate. The December figure only exists in the January release — going to bls.gov directly.
steps.note: Recovery: went back to the official release.

steps.name: select_result
steps.input: Open result [1]: bls.gov — the Employment Situation news release for December 2024 is the official source.

steps.name: open_page
steps.output: THE EMPLOYMENT SITUATION — DECEMBER 2024. Total nonfarm payroll employment increased by 256,000 in December, and the unemployment rate changed little at 4.1 percent, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported today. The number of unemployed people, at 6.9 million, changed little over the month.

steps.name: final_answer
steps.input: Compose the final answer from the verified findings.
steps.output: 4.1 percent — the December 2024 figure in the BLS Employment Situation news release.
steps.note: Recovered after initially trusting a weak source.
